description: Is OpenRAG indexing, answering and serving what it should? Ingestion, inference and retrieval, one row per question.

panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the API's /metrics. While this is down every other panel goes quiet, which is not the same as healthy.
panels.title: API scrape

panels.description: Indexing tasks waiting for a worker. Every API replica reports the same queue, so this takes the max rather than the sum. Empty means the task state could not be read, never an empty queue: an idle queue reports 0.
panels.title: Queued tasks

panels.description: Time since any parser pool last finished a document. Idle is normal when nothing is queued; queued work plus more than 12 minutes here is what OpenRagIngestStalled pages on.
panels.title: Since last parse

panels.description: Share of documents that failed among those that finished in the last 15 minutes. Cancelled uploads are left out: a user cancelling is not a failure.
panels.title: Failed documents · 15m

panels.description: Error and timeout share of the worst inference endpoint over the last 10 minutes. Calls refused by an open circuit breaker are not counted here; see Open breakers.

targets.expr: max((sum by (provider) (increase({__name__=~"(ray_)?openrag_inference_requests_total", outcome=~"error|timeout"}[10m])) or 0 * sum by (provider) (increase({__name__=~"(ray_)?openrag_inference_requests_total"}[10m]))) / (sum by (provider) (increase({__name__=~"(ray_)?openrag_inference_requests_total"}[10m])) > 0))

panels.title: Inference errors · 10m

panels.description: Circuit breakers currently open (llm, embedder, vlm, reranker). An open breaker means OpenRag has stopped calling that endpoint and fails fast instead.
panels.title: Open breakers

panels.description: Retrieval hits dropped in the last hour because their file is missing from the catalog: the vector store and Postgres disagree. Any non-zero value needs a reconciliation run.
panels.title: Catalog drift · 1h

panels.description: Documents reaching a terminal state per minute. Counted by the task state manager, so rejected submissions and cancellations of queued work are included.
panels.title: Documents finished, by outcome

panels.description: Failed share of completed and failed documents over a trailing 5 minutes, the window OpenRagIngestFailureRate reads. The dashed line is its default 25% threshold; the alert also needs at least 5 documents in 15 minutes.
panels.title: Failure ratio

panels.description: Documents that reached each terminal state over the selected time range.
panels.title: Finished in range

panels.description: Indexing tasks queued or being processed. Max across API replicas, which all read the same task state manager.
panels.title: Tasks in flight

panels.description: Time from a task's admission to the start of its processing. Seconds when idle, tens of minutes during a bulk import.
panels.title: Queue wait

panels.description: Time since each parser pool last finished a document. The dashed line is OpenRagIngestStalled's default 12 minutes, which only matters while tasks are queued. A pool nobody uploads to climbs forever; that is expected.
panels.title: Since last parse, by parser

panels.description: Queue-wait measurements that came out negative over the selected range, clamped to zero. Non-zero means API and worker clocks disagree and the Queue wait panel reads low.
panels.title: Clock-skew events

panels.description: 95th percentile duration of each indexing stage. Logarithmic: chunking takes milliseconds and a large PDF parse takes minutes.
panels.title: Stage duration p95

panels.description: Average number of documents inside each stage: seconds of stage work per second of wall clock. The tallest band is where indexing time goes.
panels.title: Documents in each stage

panels.description: Calls to external inference endpoints. Chat and rerank run in the API, embed and vlm inside indexing workers; both are summed here.
panels.title: Calls by operation

panels.description: Error and timeout share of calls per registry endpoint. The dashed line is OpenRagInferenceProviderDown's default 50%. client_override groups requests that named their own endpoint.
panels.title: Error ratio by endpoint

panels.description: Calls that did not succeed, by operation and outcome. circuit_open calls never reached the endpoint.
panels.title: Failed calls by outcome

panels.description: 95th percentile latency per registry endpoint and operation.
panels.title: Latency p95 by endpoint

panels.description: State of each circuit breaker, worst across processes. Open means calls fail fast without reaching the endpoint; half-open means a probe call is being let through.
panels.title: Circuit breakers

panels.description: Tokens consumed by LLM calls, by operation and direction. Aggregate by design: per-tenant consumption is a usage-accounting question, not a metrics one.
panels.title: LLM tokens per second

panels.description: Readiness probe result for every model endpoint in use: the per-kind defaults plus whatever partition presets name. Worst across API replicas. Not gating: a failing endpoint does not take the API out of service.
panels.title: Model endpoint readiness

panels.description: Retrieval hits dropped over the trailing hour because their file is gone from the catalog, the window OpenRagCatalogDriftDetected reads. A hit is dropped per query, so this is not a document count: only non-zero matters.
panels.title: Catalog drift

list.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes OpenRAG. Defaults to the Grafana default data source.
list.label: Data source
list.name: DS_PROMETHEUS

list.description: Scrape job of the API's /metrics, read from a gauge the API exports from startup, before it serves any request: openrag on Compose, the ServiceMonitor's Service name on Kubernetes. It carries no All value, so All is the jobs this query returns, never every target Prometheus scrapes.
list.label: API scrape job
list.name: job

title: OpenRAG Service
